## What happened

Describe the trigger and actual behavior.

## Expected behavior

Describe the expected result.

## Reproduction

Use fictional data and include the smallest relevant commands.

## Environment

Include Python version, operating system, Atmet Brain version and adapter.

## Validation

Include redacted error codes or a regression test. Do not include tokens, raw customer data or private logs.
